  <bpmn:process id="Process_WorkLivingAustria" name="Work and Live in Austria" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Main">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Applicant" name="Applicant">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Plan</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckRequirements</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Accommodation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_BankAccount</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Loop_Merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_VisaType</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_MainDest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_IdentifyMainRep</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_IdentifyFirstEntry</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_IdentifyTypeD</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_IdentifyCatAC</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Competence_Merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ContactRep</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Docs_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Form</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TravelDoc</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Photo</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Insurance</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Subsistence</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_OtherEvidence</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Docs_Join</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AddDocs</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AdditionalDocs</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Submit_Merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Submit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Renewal</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Complete</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Representation" name="Austrian Representation Office (BMEIA)">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Review</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Decision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Issue</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Refused</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Plan" name="Plan to work and live in Austria"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckRequirements" name="Check requirements for working and living in Austria"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Accommodation" name="Negotiate accommodation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BankAccount" name="Negotiate bank account"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Loop_Merge" name="Visa application cycle"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_VisaType" name="Visa type?"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MainDest" name="Main travel destination determinable?" default="Flow_MainDest_No"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_IdentifyMainRep" name="Identify representation of main travel destination"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_IdentifyFirstEntry" name="Identify representation of first Schengen entry country"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_IdentifyTypeD" name="Identify Austrian representation by place of residence (Section 8 FPG)"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_IdentifyCatAC" name="Identify representation in consular district of legal residence"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Competence_Merge" name="Competent representation identified"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ContactRep" name="Contact representation in advance for more information"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Docs_Split" name="Prepare documents"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Form" name="Complete visa application form"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TravelDoc" name="Check travel document (valid at least 3 months beyond visa duration, at least 2 empty pages, issued within last 10 years)"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Photo" name="Obtain passport photo (portrait, 35 x 45 mm)"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Insurance" name="Obtain comprehensive travel health insurance (EUR 30,000, valid in Schengen area, planned stay)"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Submit_Merge" name="Ready for submission"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Submit" name="Submit visa application"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Review" name="Review application and verify requirements"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Decision" name="Application approved (no refusal grounds)?" default="Flow_Refused"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Issue" name="Issue visa"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Renewal" name="Renewal due (every x months)?" default="Flow_Renewal_No"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Refused" name="Visa application refused"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Loop_VisaType" sourceRef="Gateway_Loop_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_VisaType"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MainDest_No" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_MainDest" targetRef="Task_IdentifyFirstEntry"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MainRep_Merge" sourceRef="Task_IdentifyMainRep" targetRef="Gateway_Competence_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FirstEntry_Merge" sourceRef="Task_IdentifyFirstEntry" targetRef="Gateway_Competence_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TypeD_Merge" sourceRef="Task_IdentifyTypeD" targetRef="Gateway_Competence_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CatAC_Merge" sourceRef="Task_IdentifyCatAC" targetRef="Gateway_Competence_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_Contact" sourceRef="Gateway_Competence_Merge" targetRef="Task_ContactRep"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Contact_Docs" sourceRef="Task_ContactRep" targetRef="Gateway_Docs_Split"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Docs_Form" sourceRef="Gateway_Docs_Split" targetRef="Task_Form"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Docs_TravelDoc" sourceRef="Gateway_Docs_Split" targetRef="Task_TravelDoc"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Docs_Photo" sourceRef="Gateway_Docs_Split" targetRef="Task_Photo"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Docs_Insurance" sourceRef="Gateway_Docs_Split" targetRef="Task_Insurance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Docs_Subsistence" sourceRef="Gateway_Docs_Split" targetRef="Task_Subsistence"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Docs_Other" sourceRef="Gateway_Docs_Split" targetRef="Task_OtherEvidence"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Form_Join" sourceRef="Task_Form" targetRef="Gateway_Docs_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TravelDoc_Join" sourceRef="Task_TravelDoc" targetRef="Gateway_Docs_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Photo_Join" sourceRef="Task_Photo" targetRef="Gateway_Docs_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Insurance_Join" sourceRef="Task_Insurance" targetRef="Gateway_Docs_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Subsistence_Join" sourceRef="Task_Subsistence" targetRef="Gateway_Docs_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Other_Join" sourceRef="Task_OtherEvidence" targetRef="Gateway_Docs_Join"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_AddDocs" sourceRef="Gateway_Docs_Join" targetRef="Gateway_AddDocs"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AddDocs_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AddDocs" targetRef="Task_AdditionalDocs">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${additionalDocsRequested == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAddDocs" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_AddDocs" targetRef="Gateway_Submit_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalDocs_Merge" sourceRef="Task_AdditionalDocs" targetRef="Gateway_Submit_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_Submit" sourceRef="Gateway_Submit_Merge" targetRef="Task_Submit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Submit_Review" sourceRef="Task_Submit" targetRef="Task_Review"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Review_Decision" sourceRef="Task_Review" targetRef="Gateway_Decision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approved" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Decision" targetRef="Task_Issue">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${applicationApproved == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Refused" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Decision" targetRef="EndEvent_Refused"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Issue_Renewal" sourceRef="Task_Issue" targetRef="Gateway_Renewal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Renewal_No" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Renewal" targetRef="EndEvent_Complete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Plan" name="Plan to work and live in Austria"/>

    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Accommodation" name="Negotiate accommodation"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_BankAccount" name="Negotiate bank account"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Cycle_Merge" name="Visa application cycle"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_VisaType" name="Visa type (Schengen, type D, category A or C)?"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MainDest" name="Main travel destination determinable?" default="Flow_MainDest_No"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_IdentifyMainRep" name="Identify representation of main travel destination"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_IdentifyFirstEntry" name="Identify representation of first Schengen entry country"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_IdentifyTypeD" name="Identify Austrian representation by place of residence (Section 8 FPG)"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_IdentifyCatAC" name="Identify representation in consular district of legal residence"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Competence_Merge" name="Competent representation identified"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ContactRep" name="Contact representation in advance for more information"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Docs_Split" name="Prepare documents"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Form" name="Complete visa application form">
      <bpmn:documentation>Visa application form.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TravelDoc" name="Provide travel document">
      <bpmn:documentation>Travel document valid in Austria, with a validity period exceeding the duration of the visa by at least three months, with at least two empty pages, issued within the last ten years.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Photo" name="Provide passport photo">
      <bpmn:documentation>Portrait format, 35 x 45 mm, in accordance with the specified passport photo criteria.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Insurance" name="Provide travel health insurance">
      <bpmn:documentation>Fully comprehensive travel health insurance policy for the planned duration of the stay, amount of cover EUR 30,000, valid for the entire Schengen area.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Subsistence" name="Provide proof of means of subsistence">
      <bpmn:documentation>Sufficient for the duration of the intended stay and for the return journey to the country of origin or residence.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OtherEvidence" name="Provide other requested evidence">
      <bpmn:documentation>Other evidence requested by the relevant authorities, e.g. hotel reservations, invitations, booking confirmations, return flight ticket, proof of gainful employment. Evidence may vary depending on location. Additional documents may be requested depending on circumstances.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Docs_Join" name="Documents prepared"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Submit" name="Submit visa application"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckVisaReq" name="Check application against visa requirements"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Renewal" name="Renewal due (every x months)?" default="Flow_Renewal_No"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Refused" name="Visa application refused"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Complete" name="Visa valid for stay"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Check" sourceRef="Start_Plan" targetRef="Task_CheckRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Check_Accom" sourceRef="Task_CheckRequirements" targetRef="Task_Accommodation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Accom_Bank" sourceRef="Task_Accommodation" targetRef="Task_BankAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_Cycle" sourceRef="Task_BankAccount" targetRef="Gateway_Cycle_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Cycle_VisaType" sourceRef="Gateway_Cycle_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_VisaType"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_VisaType_Schengen" name="Schengen visa" sourceRef="Gateway_VisaType" targetRef="Gateway_MainDest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${visaType == 'Schengen'}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_VisaType_TypeD" name="Type D visa" sourceRef="Gateway_VisaType" targetRef="Task_IdentifyTypeD">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${visaType == 'TypeD'}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_VisaType_CatAC" name="Category A or C visa" sourceRef="Gateway_VisaType" targetRef="Task_IdentifyCatAC">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${visaType == 'CategoryAC'}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MainDest_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_MainDest" targetRef="Task_IdentifyMainRep">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${mainDestinationDetermined == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MainDest_No" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_MainDest" targetRef="Task_IdentifyFirstEntry"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MainRep_Merge" sourceRef="Task_IdentifyMainRep" targetRef="Gateway_Competence_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FirstEntry_Merge" sourceRef="Task_IdentifyFirstEntry" targetRef="Gateway_Competence_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TypeD_Merge" sourceRef="Task_IdentifyTypeD" targetRef="Gateway_Competence_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CatAC_Merge" sourceRef="Task_IdentifyCatAC" targetRef="Gateway_Competence_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_Contact" sourceRef="Gateway_Competence_Merge" targetRef="Task_ContactRep"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Contact_Docs" sourceRef="Task_ContactRep" targetRef="Gateway_Docs_Split"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Docs_Form" sourceRef="Gateway_Docs_Split" targetRef="Task_Form"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Docs_TravelDoc" sourceRef="Gateway_Docs_Split" targetRef="Task_TravelDoc"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Docs_Photo" sourceRef="Gateway_Docs_Split" targetRef="Task_Photo"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Docs_Insurance" sourceRef="Gateway_Docs_Split" targetRef="Task_Insurance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Docs_Subsistence" sourceRef="Gateway_Docs_Split" targetRef="Task_Subsistence"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Docs_Other" sourceRef="Gateway_Docs_Split" targetRef="Task_OtherEvidence"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Form_Join" sourceRef="Task_Form" targetRef="Gateway_Docs_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TravelDoc_Join" sourceRef="Task_TravelDoc" targetRef="Gateway_Docs_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Photo_Join" sourceRef="Task_Photo" targetRef="Gateway_Docs_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Insurance_Join" sourceRef="Task_Insurance" targetRef="Gateway_Docs_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Subsistence_Join" sourceRef="Task_Subsistence" targetRef="Gateway_Docs_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Other_Join" sourceRef="Task_OtherEvidence" targetRef="Gateway_Docs_Join"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_Submit" sourceRef="Gateway_Docs_Join" targetRef="Task_Submit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Submit_Check" sourceRef="Task_Submit" targetRef="Task_CheckVisaReq"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Check_AddDocs" sourceRef="Task_CheckVisaReq" targetRef="Gateway_AddDocs"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AddDocs_Yes" name="Additional documents requested" sourceRef="Gateway_AddDocs" targetRef="Task_RequestAdditional">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${additionalDocsRequested == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReqMet" name="Requirements met" sourceRef="Gateway_AddDocs" targetRef="Gateway_AddDocs_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Request_Provide" sourceRef="Task_RequestAdditional" targetRef="Task_ProvideAdditional"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Provide_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ProvideAdditional" targetRef="Gateway_AddDocs_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_Grounds" sourceRef="Gateway_AddDocs_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_Grounds"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Grounds_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Grounds" targetRef="Task_Issue">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${noOtherGroundsForRefusal == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Grounds_No" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Grounds" targetRef="EndEvent_Refused"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Issue_Renewal" sourceRef="Task_Issue" targetRef="Gateway_Renewal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Renewal_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Renewal" targetRef="Gateway_Cycle_Merge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${renewalDue == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Renewal_No" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Renewal" targetRef="EndEvent_Complete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Plan" name="Plan to work and live in Austria"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckRequirements" name="Check requirements">
      <bpmn:documentation>Check the requirements for working and living in Austria.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Accommodation" name="Negotiate accommodation">
      <bpmn:documentation>Organize accommodation (negotiation by the applicant).</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_BankAccount" name="Negotiate bank account">
      <bpmn:documentation>Organize bank account (negotiation by the applicant).</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Cycle_Merge" name="Visa application cycle"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_VisaType" name="Visa type (Schengen, type D, category A or C)?"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MainDest" name="Main travel destination determinable?" default="Flow_MainDest_No"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_IdentifyMainRep" name="Identify representation of main travel destination">
      <bpmn:documentation>Schengen visa: representation of the country in whose territory the main travel destination is located, based on length and purpose of stay.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_IdentifyFirstEntry" name="Identify representation of first Schengen entry country">
      <bpmn:documentation>If no main travel destination can be determined, the member country of first entry into the Schengen area is responsible.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_IdentifyTypeD" name="Identify Austrian representation by place of residence">
      <bpmn:documentation>Type D visa: competent Austrian representation determined by place of residence (centre of interest) under Section 8 FPG.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_IdentifyCatAC" name="Identify representation in consular district of legal residence">
      <bpmn:documentation>Category A and C visas: representation office in the consular district where the legal place of residence is located. Exceptional competence may be claimed for third-country nationals legally residing but not registered in the district, with justification.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Competence_Merge" name="Competent representation identified"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ContactRep" name="Contact representation in advance for more information">
      <bpmn:documentation>Additional documents may be requested depending on circumstances. A list of representation offices is available on the website of the Federal Ministry of European and International Affairs.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Docs_Split" name="Prepare documents"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Form" name="Complete visa application form">
      <bpmn:documentation>Visa application form.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TravelDoc" name="Provide travel document">
      <bpmn:documentation>Travel document valid in Austria, with a validity period exceeding the duration of the visa by at least three months, with at least two empty pages, issued within the last ten years.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Photo" name="Provide passport photo">
      <bpmn:documentation>Portrait format, 35 x 45 mm, in accordance with the specified passport photo criteria.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Insurance" name="Provide travel health insurance">
      <bpmn:documentation>Fully comprehensive travel health insurance policy for the planned duration of the stay, amount of cover 30,000 Euro, valid for the entire Schengen area.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Subsistence" name="Provide proof of means of subsistence">
      <bpmn:documentation>Sufficient for the duration of the intended stay and for the return journey to the country of origin or residence.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OtherEvidence" name="Provide other requested evidence">
      <bpmn:documentation>Other evidence requested by the relevant authorities, e.g. hotel reservations, invitations, booking confirmations, return flight ticket, proof of gainful employment. Evidence may vary depending on location.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Submit" name="Submit visa application"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckVisaReq" name="Check application against visa requirements">
      <bpmn:documentation>Check the submitted application against the visa requirements: travel document, passport photo, travel health insurance, means of subsistence, other evidence, and absence of other grounds for refusal (residence prohibition, alert issued by a Schengen country).</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_RequestAdditional" name="Request additional documents"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideAdditional" name="Provide additional documents"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AddDocs_Merge" name="Visa requirements checked"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Grounds" name="Absence of other grounds for refusal?" default="Flow_Grounds_No">
      <bpmn:documentation>No residence prohibition and no alert issued by a Schengen country.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Issue" name="Issue visa">
      <bpmn:documentation>Generally issued by representation offices (BMEIA) abroad or, in specific exceptional cases, by certain border control posts or, where extension of the visa is permitted, by the state police headquarters. Rot-Weiss-Rot Card.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Docs_Form" sourceRef="Gateway_Docs_Split" targetRef="Task_Form"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Docs_TravelDoc" sourceRef="Gateway_Docs_Split" targetRef="Task_TravelDoc"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Docs_Photo" sourceRef="Gateway_Docs_Split" targetRef="Task_Photo"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Docs_Insurance" sourceRef="Gateway_Docs_Split" targetRef="Task_Insurance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Docs_Subsistence" sourceRef="Gateway_Docs_Split" targetRef="Task_Subsistence"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Docs_Other" sourceRef="Gateway_Docs_Split" targetRef="Task_OtherEvidence"/>

rules.instruction: When the description lists requirements that a party must meet before a later step, and states that additional documents may be requested depending on circumstances, so the requirement check can either lead onward or lead to a request for more documents: Model the requirement check as a task, then place an exclusive gateway after it with one labelled outgoing flow for the outcome where the requirements are met and one for the outcome where additional documents are requested. Put the request for documents as its own task on the second outcome branch, and do not drop that branch. Model any re-check or loop back to the check only where the description explicitly states that the supplied documents are examined again. Do not add a loop or a separate verification step that the description does not state.
rules.situation: the description lists requirements that a party must meet before a later step, and states that additional documents may be requested depending on circumstances, so the requirement check can either lead onward or lead to a request for more documents

rules.instruction: When the description states a decision that selects between alternative branches, and gives the condition or criterion for that decision in its own wording: Label the exclusive gateway with the question that the description states for that decision, using the description's own condition wording, and label each outgoing flow with the outcome it corresponds to. Do not replace the stated condition with a question about a different aspect of the process.
rules.situation: the description states a decision that selects between alternative branches, and gives the condition or criterion for that decision in its own wording

rules.instruction: When the description states a participant's sequence of actions (an initial request or search, then a choice among options, then entry of further information or payment), each described as a separate step before a system step that depends on them: Model each stated participant action as its own user task, in the order the description gives, including the opening request or search that starts the process. Connect these tasks in sequence before the system task that depends on them. Do not omit a stated action because it appears only as a clause within a sentence, and do not fold several stated actions into one task.
rules.situation: the description lists an item to be organized, and the applicant's own action for that item (such as a negotiation) appears only inside a parenthesis or clause, with no system performing that action

rules.instruction: When the description states an action on an object and then attaches a phrase giving its place, method, or the aspects it is checked against (for example, a list of criteria or a qualifying condition on where or how the action is done): Model the task with a label containing only the core verb and object taken from the description, and move the place, method, or criteria phrase into the task's documentation. Do not let the label carry the qualifier, and do not drop the qualifier from the model, since it belongs in the documentation.
rules.situation: the description lists several items an applicant must present or obtain, each followed by a parenthetical detail such as a size, format, or validity condition, and the generated model labels these items with paraphrased wording

rules.instruction: When the description lists documents or conditions that the applicant must present or fulfil before the application can proceed, and says that the requirements are checked, so the outcome decides whether the process continues or the applicant must prepare the missing items: Model a check task that compares the submitted documents with the listed requirements, followed by an exclusive gateway with one labelled outgoing flow for 'fulfilled' (continuing to the next step) and one for 'not fulfilled' (looping back to the task that prepares the missing or corrected documents). Do not omit the check, and do not merge it into the preparation task or skip the gateway.
rules.situation: the description lists documents or conditions that the applicant must present or fulfil before the application can proceed, and says that the requirements are checked, so the outcome decides whether the process continues or the applicant must prepare the missing items
